verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents an official MCP server that lets external agents like Claude, Cursor and Copilot query metrics, logs, traces and alerts. It also publishes Agent Skills for generating queries over all three signals, and service accounts give non-human systems programmatic API access. First-party use cases cover production debugging, such as reconstructing a bug from a trace ID and investigating changes after a deploy. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST query spec (the probe returned 404 at standard paths), and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents debug production through these interfaces.
